positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
-  Responsible for organizing educational programs for an apartment community floor of 37 residents
-  Conduct rounds throughout the building to assure security and enforcement of policies 
-  Serve as a resource for residents and direct them to the appropriate ones when necessary 
-  Recruit residents to participate in the departmental sponsored philanthropy effort by tabling in the community, hosting informational sessions, and talking to residents one-on one
-  Hold fundraising events for residents to learn about the organization and to raise money for the community team

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist Intern
positions.description:
-  Migrated over 35 MySQL query views to MSSQL
-  Rewrote SQL queries from an older database architecture to a newer relational database structure
-  Organized and created a 45-minute WebEx presentation on the Packaging Systems team
-  Created a sample forum guide using OneNote notebooks

positions.title: Volunteer Co-Chair
positions.description:
- Planned and organized informational sessions for recruitment	
- Adjusted volunteer needs for a conference of 2,000 attendees	
- Created a schedule for all volunteers including rotations, mealtimes, and break times	
- Replaced no-shows and completed their duties	
-  Completed a full progress report with supporting documents for NACURH 2020 conference chairs

company.name: National Association of College and University Residence Halls, Inc.

positions.title: Food Server
positions.description:
- Ensured customer satisfaction by fulfilling orders accurately and efficiently
- Communicated and resolved issues for customers to provide a pleasant experience
- Trained new staff on proper technique and protocol
- Applied fluency in Spanish by aiding non-English speakers
